QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] The Kappa and I
QuestInfo.0: Visit Yorozu at the Mushroom Shrine and ask her to be your friend.
QuestInfo.1: Yorozu will not speak to you without Tengu's approval. Speak to Tengu. You may need to be on better terms before Tengu will consider your request.
QuestInfo.2: Tengu said he would have a talk with Yorozu. Speak with Yorozu again.
